hooks.command: : 'codex-alpha-goal-compact-recovery:v1'; printf '%s\n' 'Compact recovery policy:' 'After compaction, before the next substantive action, decide whether one or more candidate skills below applies to the current task.' 'If a candidate applies, invoke and load that skill before acting; treat pre-compaction remembered skill text as stale.' 'For active Alpha Goal tasks, resume from accepted goal-contract.md first; use control-state/latest.md only when task identity is ambiguous; use checkpoint.md when it exists or when trigger/action/evidence/verification rules require it.' 'If checkpoint.md exists, inspect relevant Run Profile, Loop State, Verification, and Evidence sections before acting; verification-triggered recovery requires Verdict: NEXT_ITERATION, Next route: control-loop, and a same-goal fixable Gap.' 'If none applies, continue normally without loading these skills.' 'Candidate skills:' '- $alpha-goal: use for requirements, goal framing, design, scope, acceptance evidence, decision boundaries, and claim boundaries.' '- $control-loop: use for bounded implementation or hardening after an explicit goal specification.' '- $goal-verify: use for goal completion/readiness/review/audit verification, including evidence coverage, claim boundary, defect/risk sweep, and material unclaimed issues.'
hooks.statusMessage: Refreshing Alpha Goal compact recovery policy
